Why local matters for this work

Most AI consulting happens over video, and for a lot of it that is fine. For two parts of it, it is not.

The first is the assessment. Watching how work actually happens — the paper on the desk, the three screens, the call that interrupts everything — tells you things nobody reports in an interview. The documented process and the real process are different in every business we have worked in, and the gap is where the value usually is.

The second is a private deployment. When the system runs on hardware in your building, somebody eventually needs to be in the room with it.

Where we work

Palm Beach County, Broward and Miami-Dade for on-site work — Wellington, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Jupiter, Deerfield Beach, Coral Springs, Fort Lauderdale and Miami. Our client list already spans Miami-Dade to Palm Beach, and we work with businesses nationwide remotely.

South Florida businesses we already build for

Manufacturing and industrial hardware, pool and outdoor services, automotive customisation, product development, document destruction, swim schools and healthcare — the specifics are on the client work and industries pages.

Getting in touch

Call (561) 235-0799, email ai@felican.ai, or book a time. We serve clients at their sites rather than from a storefront, so there is nowhere to walk into — the first conversation is a call or a visit to you.
